Thankfully, no mannequins with their heads cut off in this, which is the only thing that held back the first part IMO.

I kept the "filming" tag on here even though they clearly say it's a photo album they're making, because I'm not sure if that counts for photography too. They're being recorded either way, so whatever.

Happy fapping!
